name: Three-position centre-return selector
summary: A centre-return selector returns from both outer positions to its documented central rest position.
description: A centre-return selector returns from both outer positions to its documented central rest position. It can issue opposite momentary commands without retaining either outer position.
readingNotes: The centre rest position still needs a defined contact state.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Centre return describes the mechanism; centre off describes a contact condition.
